units.source_text: 且说柏木看了小侍从的回信，觉得道理固然不错，然而言语太冷酷了。

en.t: Now Kashiwagi read Kojiju's reply and felt that, although its reasoning was certainly sound, its words were far too cold.
He thought, "No, this will not do!

units.source_text: 她用寻常敷衍的话来搪塞，教我如何肯罢休呢！

en.t: If she brushes me off with ordinary evasive words, how could I possibly give up!

units.source_text: 我总想不用侍女传言，当面与公主谈谈，即使一句话也好。”

en.t: I have always wanted to speak with the princess face to face, without messages passed through a maid, even if it is only a single word."

units.source_text: 于是对于他所一向敬爱的源氏，不免发生了厌恶之念。

en.t: And so, toward Genji, whom he had always revered, he could not help beginning to feel resentment.
